description.value: Sport Chek at Metropolis @ Metrotown is a large-format Canadian sporting goods chain located inside one of BC's busiest shopping malls in Burnaby. The store carries bikes, cycling apparel, and accessories across multiple sport categories, and the chain operates an equipment servicing program at many locations. For a touring cyclist, it is a useful stop for gear, clothing, and possibly basic parts in an otherwise commercially dense area.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (covered) at 46m; rack at 75m.
